newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News preferred shares top turnover.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News preferred shares top turnover.

text.p: The preferred ordinary shares of News Corporation Ltd topped turnover lists early on Tuesday with over 40.4 million shares traded.

The bulk of the trade was in six lines totalling 40 million shares specialled through First Pacific Stockbroking, all at a price of A$5.71 per share. Brokers said the trade appeared to be offshore institutional business.
By 10.45 a.m. (2345 GMT), News preferred ordinary shares were seven cents higher at A$5.77, while News Corp ordinary shares were 10 cents higher at A$6.80.
